Balance sheet: assets 5500.00 + 1100.00 + 600.00 = 7200.00 = equity (owner_equity 6000.00 + current_period_earnings 1200.00) 7200.00 (no liabilities). Cash flow: net_income 1200.00 + owner_equity +6000.00 − prepaid_insurance 1100.00 (asset increase, use of cash) − prepaid_rent 600.00 (same) = 5500.00, matching ending_cash 5500.00 − beginning_cash 0.00.

2026-12 (December, standalone month, after the 2026-12-31 closing entry): December's own activity is identical to every other month. Balance sheet after closing: assets cash 20400.00 (prepaid balances both 0.00) = equity (owner_equity 6000.00 + retained_earnings 14400.00, the full year's net income + current_period_earnings 0.00) 20400.00.

2026 (full fiscal year 1): revenue 12×1600.00=19200.00, insurance 12×100.00=1200.00 (one annual prepayment, fully amortized), rent 12×300.00=3600.00 (four quarterly prepayments of 900.00 = 3600.00, fully amortized), net income 14400.00. Balance sheet: assets 20400.00 = equity (6000.00 + 14400.00) 20400.00.
